notes.title: Dragon Star Varnir™ Will Release A Day Early on October 8!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/d82c28f280533a4d61f5765f5e172f575e4e5833.png[/img]

[b]Awaken the Dragon within![/b] Previously it was stated that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062040/Dragon_Star_Varnir/][b]Steam®[/b][/url] release of [url=http://ideafintl.com/varnir/][i][b]Dragon Star Varnir™[/b][/i][/url] will launch on [b]October 9, but now... the epic dragon RPG will be released A DAY EARLY on October 8, with a 20% weeklong launch discount[/b]!

Originally released on the PlayStation®4, the Steam version will include ALL gameplay and art content from the Japanese version, as well as English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.

Upon launch, Steam users will be able to grab the[b] Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack) at a permanent 10% discount[/b]. The [b]Deluxe Pack[/b] will also have a weeklong 20% discount and includes:​

[list]
[*] Character and Background Art Collection​
[*] Rough Art Collection​
[*] PC Wallpaper (x3)​
[*] Mobile Wallpaper (x6)​
[*] Soundtrack (12 tracks)
[/list]

Taking place in a world where witches are cursed to give birth to dragons, one man tasked with hunting them soon finds his own fate intertwined with his former enemies. Fight against dragons in turn-based, midair combat, using tiers, transformations, and more to weaken them and devour their abilities! The fate of three witches is in your hands – will you choose to save them or sacrifice them to gain items and skills? Your decisions will change the course of the game!​

Add Dragon Star Varnir to your wishlist today!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062040/Dragon_Star_Varnir/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1062040/Dragon_Star_Varnir/[/url]

Check out the Deluxe Pack contents below!

[h1][b]Deluxe Pack[/b][/h1]

[b]Character and Background Art Collection[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/fab973bc7b053ce0c5266659982356cc47039175.png[/img]

[b]Rough Art Collection[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/676ff50152d7be392d577014c0f7247f26fea0e5.png[/img]

[b]PC Wallpaper (x3)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/943d7b08ba668ea7d0a478ded92bb26f2496eba2.png[/img]

[b]Mobile Phone Wallpapers (x6)[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/4454fe469b66b963f28b3faef96ed4d57b938e55.png[/img]    [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/04475243b326f575f8bb3f92df709f45c6f0873d.png[/img]

notes.title: Moero Chronicle [UPDATE 1.0.15]
notes.notes:
Hi monster girl enthusiasts! We've updated the build today 10/5/17 with the following fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Scylla’s portrait animations
[*] The left mouse button can now be used to switch between information pages in the Pictoral Book 
[*] The left mouse button can now be used to navigate between different versions of an image in the Gallery
[*] Fixed image flickering that occurs when moving the mouse cursor over older rooms within REBUILD
[/list]

Thanks for your patience and feedback as we got these fixed! Should other troubles arise, please continue using our Iffy's Tech Support subforums to search for tech help. You can also visit our PC form [url=https://www.ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php] here[/url] to give us feedback directly. 

Have a good one!
-Orion

notes.title: Moero Chronicle UPDATE [1.0.11]
notes.notes:
Monster girl collecting should go more smoothly with today’s update 9/20/17! Here are the improvements and fixes we’ve added with the new build: 

[list]
[*] Adjusted controls so that Monster Girls can be selected with a mouse during Io’s “Release” function
[*] Adjusted controls so that chests in dungeons can be retrieved with a mouse
[*] Adjusted spacing of Title Menu graphic text in English and Chinese
[*] Adjusted graphics of the background to the Mushroom Forest dungeon
[*] Fixed an issue where the top part of the application window would be cut off in 1920x1080 windowed display
[*] Changed the text “Decide Button” to “Confirm Button”
[/list]

Thanks for your patience and feedback! Should other troubles arise, our Iffy's Tech Support subforums may be of some help. Or, you can visit our PC form [url=https://www.ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php] here[/url] to give us feedback directly. 

We've also uploaded the digital manual for Moero Chronicle! You can find it on the right hand side of the Moero Chronicle store page. Links here for your convenient viewing pleasure:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/638160/manuals/Moero_Chronicle_Manual_ENG.pdf?t=1505945318]English[/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/638160/manuals/Moero_Chronicle_Manual_JPN.pdf?t=1505945318]日本語[/url]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/638160/manuals/Moero_Chronicle_Manual_CHT.pdf?t=1505945318]繁體中文[/url] 


Enjoy Moero Chronicle! 
-Orion

notes.title: Moero Chronicle UPDATE [1.0.10]
notes.notes:
Some good news for you and your monster girls! We've updated the build  today 9/13/17 with the following improvements and fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking on a monster girl’s clothing would not attack that clothing
[*] Fixed an issue where cursor movement sound effects were not uniform on the Settings menu
[*] Fixed issues on clicking enemy graphics to attack
[*] Fixed the quality of Io’s store animation
[*] Fixed the quality of Otton’s now loading graphic
[*] Changed when changes in the A/B confirmation button’s setting goes into effect
[*] Fixed issues where left clicking on characters in the gallery would cause a crash
[*] Fixed issues with the enemy damage graphics within battles
[*] Fixed an issue where mouth animations would stop mid-animation when clicking to skip text
[/list]

We hope that your quest to capture Monster Girls will go a whole lot smoother now!

Thanks for your patience and feedback! Should other troubles arise, our Iffy's Tech Support subforums are where you can search for tech help. You can also visit our PC form [url=https://www.ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php] here[/url] to give us feedback directly. 

Cheers!
-Orion

notes.title: Moero Chronicle UPDATE 1.0.08
notes.notes:
Hey dungeon crawlers! We've updated the build today 9/1/17 with the following improvements:

[list]
[*]Fixed issue where moving to different floors cause crashes for some users
[*]Fixed issue where background music would stop playing when receiving keys for sealed areas
[*]Fixed issue where the mouse hitbox on some characters in the EXTRA section were displaced
[*]Fixed Siren’s character portrait display
[*]Fixed an issue where Rushing Radish’s turn card would display incorrectly
[*]Fixed an issue in battles where clicking on enemies to attack would attack other enemies than the one clicked
[*]Fixed an issue where the A/B Confirmation button would not save between application runtimes
*Note: The change will take effect immediately, before saving the settings.
[*]Changed the A button to the default confirm button
[*]Adjusted controls configuration so buttons can have multiple functions assigned
[/list]

Thanks for your patience through some of these issues. If there are other problems, please continue using our Iffy's Tech Support subforums to search for help and our PC form [url=https://www.ideafintl.com/pcsupport.php] here[/url] to give us feedback. 

Enjoy playing!
-Orion
